**Looking up ChartHop info**

I need to provide a reliable answer about what ChartHop does. Since company information often changes, I want to make sure I'm up to date. I could share what I know, but that might not reflect the latest facts. To ensure accuracy, it’s best to browse their official site for the most current details. Let’s search it!

**Ensuring citation accuracy**

I realize I need a concise answer with citations included throughout the response. Since I've already accessed the web for information, it's essential to ensure that every factual statement I present is well-supported with appropriate citations. This ensures credibility and provides users with reliable sources they can check. I want to make sure I get this right for the user!

ChartHop is a people operations / organizational intelligence platform. In practice, it connects HR, finance, and business data into a live model of your organization so teams can handle things like org charts, headcount planning, compensation, performance, engagement, goals, and analytics in one place. ([charthop.com](https://www.charthop.com/?utm_source=openai))

A simple way to think about it: it’s meant to help HR and Finance stop relying on spreadsheets and instead make workforce decisions with current data and built-in workflows. ([charthop.com](https://www.charthop.com/?utm_source=openai))

If you want, I can also give you:
- a 1-sentence explanation,
- a “how it compares to Workday/BambooHR” version, or
- a plain-English example of how a company would use it.

About ChartHop

# Nobody set out to run their organization from a spreadsheet.

ChartHop is the organizational intelligence company. Our platform connects your people and business data from any source into a living model of your whole organization, with HCM and planning workflows, visual analytics and agentic AI running throughout, so every decision makes your company stronger.

Hundreds

of companies plan, lead and grow their teams on ChartHop

100+

HRIS, ATS, CRM and finance systems connected

SOC 2 Type 2

examined by Schellman & Company

Any system. Every decision.

## Our mission.

To connect everything an organization knows about itself into a living model, so every decision is made in context.

Organizational intelligence means the whole company runs on a living model, kept current by continuous syncs rather than quarterly extracts. What is organizational intelligence? →

How we got here

## A note from our founder.

I founded ChartHop to create greater transparency and alignment in organizations.
We meet your data where it lives, so the whole picture reaches everyone entitled to see it.

### People problems don't stay in HR.

Every people decision lands somewhere else: a number, a deadline, a customer. Managers make the call, HR records it, Finance pays for it, and nobody sees all three. We bring people, work, money and customer data together.

### The only thing constant is change.

Organizations are never finished. Teams reshape, budgets move, people leave, and none of it waits for the quarter to end. A living company can't be run from a static picture of itself, so the model updates as the company does.

What we build

## Six modules with visual analytics and agentic AI available throughout.

See the platform →

HRIS →Handle records, onboarding, time off and payroll integrations on the same model as everything else.Headcount Planning →Plan, approve and track headcount with the cost of every change visible, and scenarios kept separate from approved reality.Compensation →Run merit, promotion and equity cycles with budgets, bands and approvals built in.【

## Frequently asked questions

##### What is organizational intelligence?

ImageImage

Organizational intelligence connects everything a company knows about itself — its people, its work, what it costs and what it produces — into a living model of the whole organization, and carries the workflows and agents to act on it.

It covers the whole organization, not just the workforce. It builds from the systems you already run instead of replacing them. It's current by default and it remembers how the organization changed and why, so you can model what happens next before you commit. And it acts — the performance review, the comp plan, the org change all happen on the same model the analysis came from.

##### How is organizational intelligence different from people analytics?

ImageImage

People analytics tells you what's happening in your workforce. 
In short, just about everything. We have a deep, two-way sync with ADP Workforce Now and ChartHop integrates with leading HRIS, ATS, and FP&A systems, including ADP, Greenhouse, Ashby, and more. We’re designed to be the "visual layer" that sits on top of your existing stack, not another silo.

##### How long does it take to get up and running?

ImageImage

We’re built for speed. Because of our deep native integrations, most teams can see their live data visualized in a beautiful org chart on day one. We don’t believe in six-month "implementation marathons"—our goal is to get you out of spreadsheets and into strategic planning in weeks, not months.

##### Why do teams choose ChartHop over other tools?

ImageImage

Most HR systems treat people data as static records that are useful for transactions, but disconnected from how the business actually operates.

ChartHop is built on people data. It continuously captures how your organization changes over time and connects that data to business context like headcount plans, compensation, performance, and goals. This creates a living system that shows not just who your organization is today, but how it’s evolving and what those changes mean for the business.

Instead of exporting data into spreadsheets or slides, leaders can use ChartHop to model scenarios, understand tradeoffs, and make decisions with people data at the core.

##### Do I have to switch my payroll to use ChartHop?

ImageImage

Not at all. In fact, many of our happiest customers keep their existing payroll provider (like ADP or Gusto) and use ChartHop as their strategic "cockpit" for analytics and planning. We sync your payroll data automatically so your org chart and budgets are always 100% accurate.

##### How does AI actually help in ChartHop?

ImageImage

AI in ChartHop helps turn complex workforce data into clear, actionable insight.Instead of digging through reports, leaders can ask questions, surface patterns, and understand trends across people and business data so teams can move faster and make more confident decisions.

##### Is ChartHop secure?

ImageImage

Yes. ChartHop is built with enterprise-grade security and privacy standards to protect sensitive people and business data.

The official ChartHop app for Teams is under review by Microsoft and will be listed in the Teams store once approved.
## Frequently asked questions

Common questions about ChartHop's latest features

Does ChartHop work with Microsoft Teams?

Yes. ChartHop sends notifications, task assignments, and approval requests to Teams, supports Teams as a destination for automated actions, and runs the full Ask ChartHop experience natively in Teams with streaming responses and citations. The official app is pending listing in the Teams store, and CSMs can help customers install it now.

Can ChartHop AI create surveys?

Yes. Ask ChartHop builds an entire survey assessment from a plain-language description, including questions, scale choices, and audience configuration, then handles creation, activation, and sending in one flow. It matches the rating scales used on previous surveys so scoring stays consistent. Available for Engagement customers.

Can ChartHop AI read meeting transcripts?

Yes. Ask ChartHop can access and search transcripts from Gong, Zoom, and Google Meet, so you can ask what a call covered and get an answer grounded in what was said. Transcripts are indexed and searchable across all your meetings. Ask your CSM to enable it.

How does calibration work in ChartHop?

Admins configure a calibration view once, setting columns, filters, and sort orders, and ChartHop generates a scoped version for each leader, manager, and HRBP containing only the employees they're responsible for calibrating. Recipients get a direct link by email and don't need full performance review access.

What is ChartHop?

ChartHop is an AI-powered people operations platform that unifies headcount planning, HRIS, compensation, performance, engagement, and goals, and connects them to the business and financial data that drives organizational decisions. Because everything lives in one system, HR and Finance work from the same source of truth and leaders get real-time answers about their organization.

## Frequently asked questions

Common questions about ChartHop's latest features

What is ChartHop?+

ChartHop is an AI-powered people operations platform that unifies headcount planning, HRIS, compensation, performance, engagement, and goals, and connects them to the business and financial data that drives organizational decisions. Because everything lives in one system, HR and Finance work from the same source of truth and leaders get real-time answers about their organization.

What is ChartHop AI Pro?+

AI Pro is a ChartHop module that lets organizations build custom AI agents and run agentic workflows that take action across their tech stack. Agents work in Slack and Teams, connect to tools like Salesforce, Notion, and GitHub using each user's own permissions, and operate within ChartHop's access controls and audit logging.

Can ChartHop AI make changes to my org data?+

Yes. With Build with AI, ChartHop AI can update titles, reassign departments, create dashboards, set goals, and assign tasks through conversation. It always shows a summary for approval first and only makes changes the user is already authorized to make.

Does ChartHop integrate with ADP Workforce Now?+

Yes. ChartHop offers a two-way sync with ADP Workforce Now, including onboarding template mapping, 100+ field mappers, and automatic data formatting, so ChartHop can serve as the source of truth for the new-hire flow into ADP.

What is a Nine Box, and does ChartHop support it?+

A Nine Box is a talent-review matrix that plots employees by performance and potential. ChartHop supports a built-in Nine Box (and twelve- and sixteen-box variants) in Data Explorer, running on live people data with readable labels and clean financial formatting.
